name: star-island
description: 星星岛大冒险：5-10岁寓教于乐静态网页游戏

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name=star-island --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4 pages dev dist
scripts.voice: node tools/collect_voice.cjs && python3 tools/gen_voice.py /tmp/voice_all.json && sh tools/trim_voice.sh
scripts.deploy:init: npx -y wrangler@4 pages project create star-island --production-branch=main
